normalized.description: The CARE-C of The Cyprus Institute is required to proceed with the purchase compact dual-wavelength LIDAR for vertical profiling of aerosols and clouds. In the framework of the European Research Infrastructure ACTRIS (Aerosols, Clouds and Trace Gases - https://www.actris.eu), the Cyprus Institute is involved with their state-of-the-art in situ instrumentation and UAV platform. The need of the CAO team in order to achieve continuous monitoring of aerosols and clouds vertical profiles with a high vertical resolution is the purchase of a lightweight, compact, automatic LIDAR system capable to perform reliable measurements of aerosol layers’ height, extinction coefficient profiles and aerosol concentration coincident during UAV scientific flights. Such instrument, namely the LIDAR was identified as the instrument suitable for this.
